diagnostics.message: `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner` applies a Karpenter `Provisioner` whose `spec.providerRef.name` is `default`, i.e. it references the `AWSNodeTemplate` named `default` that is created by `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template`. Karpenter cannot launch nodes for this provisioner until that AWSNodeTemplate exists, so the provisioner must be applied after the node template. Currently the provisioner only declares a dependency on `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons` and has no dependency (implicit or `depends_on`) on `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template`, so both CR objects can be applied concurrently / in the wrong order.
